data.content_ref: inline:The isolated problem 0e26d6be54fd shares mechanism with the harness spec v1.5 amendment (SRC_004): the conjecture-criticism loop's normative design creates a structural tendency toward isolation when the covering principle (school-2 unifier stance) is not enforced. The harness adjudicates candidates against criteria like hv-floor and lineage-ref, but without explicit integration mandates, refuted candidates accumulate and the artifact drifts from its neighbourhood. The isolation is an emergent property of the harness's own criticism dynamics. REFUTED IF: the v1.5 amendment already contains an explicit integration mandate that should prevent isolation, or if isolation occurs at the same rate under any harness configuration — suggesting the mechanism is external to the harness design.
